details: For every finite binary class, $\mathrm{SCO}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{sd}(\mathcal H)+1$.
proof: This is the first inequality of Theorem 12 in the cited paper, obtained by applying a Borsuk--Ulam argument to any SCO reduction.
name: SCO Dimension / Spherical Dimension (affine)
witness_verification: The established values on #classes/three_code_class are $2$ and $1$, respectively, so the reverse exact inequality fails. These finite values do not establish an unbounded affine gap.
